summary: Set 012 session 2 (FINAL): authored docs/playbook/ai-assisted-workflow.md — the AI-assistance companion to the session-1 human playbook. Part 1 states the core discipline (AI drafts; the platform's CNBConfig.validate() and the human verify; grounded in the repo's own never-emit-an-underivable-value philosophy). Part 2 is a pipeline map tagging each of the playbook's 12 build-walkthrough steps High/Lower/Human for AI value with the platform machinery that verifies each. Part 3 gives eight fill-in prompt templates for the high-value steps (characterize-a-system, staff pattern, ledger templates, notehead rules, clef/keysig config, validate()-error interpretation, SVG glyph geometry, export-render-diff loop), each embedding the schema excerpt/doc pointer and ending with a platform-check verification instruction. Part 4 is cautions (mandatory validate(), mandatory visual geometry check, never-guess/record-unknowns, invariants can't be prompted away, aesthetics reserved to the human, IP posture). Added a README 'Designing a Notation System' section linking both playbook docs and a forward pointer from the human playbook to the AI guide; wrote change-log.md closing the expansion program (sets 008-012). Every capability claim cites schema/module/fixture; every limitation is invariant-framed with exemplars in the cited playbook Part 2. Operator UAT: 'Approved as-is' on both documents (s2-uat.md). Docs-only: full suite 709 passed/0 failed, unchanged; no product code, no new fixtures. Routed cross-provider verification VERIFIED (gpt-5-4, 2 rounds; round 1 found 2 internal-consistency issues — missing templates for two High-tagged steps, and an emit-null vs must-validate contradiction in the characterization template — both remediated in commit 4942b9c).

reason.specifics: Final session of set 012 and of the expansion program (sets 008-012); both playbook documents are complete, cross-linked, VERIFIED, and operator-approved. No further session in this set; a future set would start fresh from the project plan.
